integrity: All statements are mathematical calculations for the printed polynomial vector field. Airy asymptotics, rather than finite experiments, provide infinite-time proofs; finite numerical checks are reproducibility diagnostics only.
scientific_limitations: Only the transverse variational equation along noncompact axial solutions is studied. The first-passage estimate is not a nonlinear escape estimate; no attractor or invariant probability is inferred. Unindexed equivalences remain possible.
title: Airy transverse dichotomy and sharp linearized departure time near a drifting quadratic-flow axis
